js: 'An attached MCP server that cannot be reached: the turn goes on without it, and its notice is a block of its own above the reply, never in the reply text: while the model reads its prompt, while its tokens stream, after the reply is stored, and in the thread read again later. Needs the mock with a slow prefill (ECHO=1 PREFILL_DELAY=5 STREAM_DELAY=0.5 scripts/mock-openai.py PORT), the fake-echo alias, and two MCP servers: notes (scripts/mock-mcp.py over stdio) and down (http://127.0.0.1:9/mcp, nothing listening); scripts/chat-drives.sh sets them up. Writes one thread and its two messages.'

(() => { localStorage.removeItem('lmgw.notices.tid'); (async () => { const j = (u, b) => fetch(u, {method: 'POST', headers: {'content-type': 'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify(b)}); const t = await (await j('/chat/api/threads', {model_alias: 'fake-echo', kind: 'chat'})).json(); await j(`/chat/api/threads/${t.id}/settings`, {mcp_tools: [{server_label: 'down'}, {server_label: 'notes'}]}); localStorage.setItem('lmgw.notices.tid', String(t.id)); })(); return 'creating a thread with two servers'; })()

label: a thread with the two servers

js: (() => { const ta = document.querySelector('.composer-input'); ta.value = 'hello there'; ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); return 'typed'; })()

until: (() => { const l = (() => { const a = [...document.querySelectorAll('.chat-col .msg-assistant')]; return a[a.length - 1] || null; })(); if (!l) return false; const n = [...l.querySelectorAll('.msg-notices .msg-notice')]; const md = l.querySelector('.md').textContent; return n.length === 1 && n[0].textContent.includes("MCP server 'down'") && !md.includes('MCP server') && !md.includes('\u26a0') && n[0].compareDocumentPosition(l.querySelector('.md')) === Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING; })()
label: while the model reads its prompt: the notice is its own block above the reply

expect: (() => { const l = (() => { const a = [...document.querySelectorAll('.chat-col .msg-assistant')]; return a[a.length - 1] || null; })(); return l.querySelector('.md').textContent.trim() === '' && !!l.querySelector('.caret'); })()
label: the reply has no words yet and streams

expect: (async () => { const d = await (await fetch('/chat/api/threads/' + localStorage.getItem('lmgw.notices.tid'))).json(); const a = d.messages.find(m => m.role === 'assistant'); return a.content === 'Echo: hello there' && a.notices.length === 1 && a.notices[0].server_label === 'down' && a.notices[0].code === 'tool_failed'; })()
